note: chat-head models for the dialogue box's 32x32 head widget (see src/tools/cache-bake/heads-bake-run.mjs). One entry per character key, baked at scale 1 (model units / 128) against its speaker's own idle sequence - a real `stand` animation the dialogue box plays, since the widget is animated; a speaker with no stand sequence carries one synthetic rest frame instead. The widget's own zoom is applied by the renderer (src/scene.js#drawChatHead, src/dialogue.js#drawHeadInto).
